blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local stocks fell further on Tuesday as rising US Treasury yields and persistent tensions between the United States and Iran dampened investor appetite. The benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) shed 0.87 percent, or 50.47 points, to close at 5,738.40.
